magnet.capture_bar: encapsulates the magnet only; it is not a panel hook, sill, or latch

lighting.architecture: External regulated nominal 5V USB. Parallel warm-white 5-12V DC Chip/Nano LEDs, each with its own supplied resistor.
rejected: one shared resistor for several bare LEDs
coin cells, loose lithium cells, or charging in the house
AA boost as the default supply

alternatives.regulated_12V: Possible with the same pre-resistored 5-12V LEDs. The 6V PPTC candidate is not usable on 12V. Not the default.
alternatives.aa_boost: Optional later module, 3xAA plus a 5.2V boost, in its own bay. Not modeled. Not the default. No parallel connection with the USB supply.

lighting.feedthrough_note: Smooth 2 mm feed for unconnectorized LED leads only. A resistor or a plug does not pass this hole.
lighting.riser_note: The spine is added behind the rear wall. Corner posts are not hollowed out. 14 x 10 is this house's chase because every circuit drops here. 12 x 8 was the research minimum.
lighting.optional_battery_bay: Not in this cabinet. A separate 100 x 80 x 35 holder plus a 40 x 35 x 15 converter area would be a later module.
lighting.supply_example: Adafruit 501 is an out-of-stock voltage example, not a kit to buy.
lighting.protection_note: Littelfuse 1206L050 (6V, 0.5A hold) is not selected. It is not sole protection for unknown fine LED wire, and its resistance can drop a 5V bus. A current-limited bench test is still required.

route: LED in the fixture cavity on a fixed plate, wall, or porch post

lighting.panel_rule: No conductor is routed on a removable panel or a lift-off roof. Roofs have no LEDs and no disconnect. Pulling a panel leaves the harness on the frame.

magnet_install_steps: Print the coupon pair and seat it before the house. The slot is the same cutter as the wall stiles.
The panel pulls straight off. There is no sill hook, no side groove, and no slide-then-lift.
An adult inserts a nominal 5.0 x 2.8 mm disc into each chamber, then slides the capture bar in from the top.
The bar closes the magnet. It does not catch the frame. Six pairs hold each facade. That holding force is not calculated and has not been measured.
Polarity: use the shallow fixture, then take the discs out. Do not leave loose discs in the house.
No pause-print profile was made. If a bar cracks, the disc can be exposed. This is not a child-safety certification.
limits: Not printed. No slicer run, no H3C test, no strength test, no fatigue test.
Zero overlap is not a structural proof. Roof uplift is not locked.
Magnet grade is unknown. Panel weight is carried by the magnets only, and that has not been pull-tested.
LED cavity 6 x 6 x 3 mm is a reservation. Chip/Nano size, 5V current, and brightness are not known.
Fixture count is this house, not the 24-LED research scenario. 20 mA is a planning figure, not a measurement.
Protection is not selected. A 6V 0.5A PPTC is not sole protection and can drop a 5V bus.
No mains in the house. USB 5V is the intended supply. The cited 5V adapter was out of stock and is not a buy list.
Service covers are adult parts. Keep them captive in the grooves. No coin cells and no charging.

legacy_interface.note: Measured on floor_tile_v0 and snap_post_v0. This house does not use that socket.
